instruction.text: Michael is going to the shops in 3 hours and 12 minutes. How long is this in minutes?

atoms.a: If the clock above is the current time, use the 24-hour clock to write what time Michael will be leaving this afternoon.

instruction.text: Nancy has to catch a bus in 321 minutes. How long is this in hours and minutes?

atoms.a: If the clock above is the current time, use the 24-hour clock to write what time the bus is this afternoon.

instruction.text: Freddie visited his aunt 2 hours and 47 minutes ago. How long is this in minutes?

atoms.a: If the clock above is the current time, use the 24-hour clock to write what time he visited her this morning.

instruction.text: Jenny woke up 453 minutes ago. How long is this in hours and minutes?

atoms.a: If the clock above is the current time, use the 24-hour clock to write what time she woke up this morning.

instruction.text: Cleo had a dentist’s appointment 729 minutes ago. How long is this in hours and minutes?

atoms.a: If the clock above is the current time in the evening, use the 24-hour clock to write what time she had her appointment this morning.
